module_boundary.details: All components live under frontend/src/{app/admin/, components/, lib/, types/} — within M-006 UI module per HLD §3. No component reaches into backend/ paths or imports backend models. The integration boundary is enforced through lib/api/dashboard.ts + lib/api/reports.ts wrappers; no component imports lib/mocks.ts directly. This mirrors the S2 ui_spec.json pattern for transactions.
boundary_observations: Place-options for the multi-select filter are DERIVED from the loaded dealers list (lib/api/masters.ts already exposes Dealer.place). The UI does not create a new endpoint or query a new module — it consumes an existing M-001 master endpoint and derives the unique set client-side. Clean.

api_contract.details: All declared api_deps map exactly to LLD-declared interfaces.exports for S3 routers + S1 existing endpoints. No undeclared endpoints, no misnamed paths, no mismatched query-param shapes.

api_contract.list_serialization_note_acknowledged: Spec correctly flags that axios must serialize list params as repeat-key (?dealer_ids=1&dealer_ids=2), NOT comma-joined — FastAPI's native list parsing depends on this. This is a /ases-ui-scaffold S3 implementation responsibility, called out explicitly in the spec under integration_boundary_note.

warnings.topic: Frontend type names vs spec text
warnings.description: Spec text references `DealerRead` and `TradingDesignRead` (backend Pydantic schema names) in the SalesReportView api_deps. The actual frontend type names in frontend/src/types/masters.ts are `Dealer` and `Design` (S1 convention). /ases-ui-scaffold should use the existing frontend type names, not invent new ones to match the spec text verbatim.
warnings.resolution: scaffold-time clarification only — no spec change required

warnings.description: Spec derives the available 'places' multi-select options from the loaded dealers' .place values, deduped. This is correct for V1 scale (single-digit users, small dealer count). At V2 scale this could miss historical place_snapshot values that exist in sales_header but no longer appear on any active dealer (because a dealer was edited or deleted). Not blocking — V1 dealer set is small and stable, but worth tracking.
warnings.resolution: carry-forward as a V2 consideration; possibly add a GET /api/v1/sales/places-distinct endpoint or expand the derivation source to include sales_header.place values

warnings.description: The ui_spec.md ASCII layout shows '28 ✓' next to BOTH the Consolidation header AND the Transactions header, but the component definition specifies a single component that receives both sums. /ases-ui-scaffold can render ONE badge (e.g. in the page header next to the filter bar) OR TWO mirrored badges (one per section) — either is consistent with the underlying single component. The .md diagram is illustrative, not prescriptive.
warnings.resolution: scaffold-time choice; recommend ONE badge near the filter bar for less visual noise (the section headers are already labeled)

warnings.topic: URL cleanup when filters are cleared
warnings.description: Spec URL-syncs filters via Next.js useSearchParams + router.replace. When the user clicks Reset, the URL should drop the now-empty params (e.g. /admin/reports/sales WITHOUT trailing `?` or empty `&dealer_ids=`). Not explicitly stated in the spec but a sensible implementation detail.
warnings.resolution: scaffold should use URLSearchParams cleanup logic to drop empty params before router.replace

strengths_noted: Integration-boundary pattern faithfully mirrors S2's lib/api/transactions.ts — Sonnet's swap step at /ases-ui-scaffold S3 will be a 1-line change per function, same as S2.
Apply-button-batched FilterBar avoids the common pitfall of refetching on every keystroke across 5 filter controls.
URL sync makes deep-linked dashboards (e.g. screenshots in WhatsApp 'show me last Friday's stock') trivially bookmarkable.
ReconciliationBadge is a thoughtful addition — server already asserts AC-050, but the visible green tick is high-trust UX feedback.
TD-010 closure path is concretely specified (native-select shim in MultiSelectCombobox test path).
AC-049 'no tabs, no toggle, Consolidation first' is explicitly encoded in SalesReportView's interactions text — eliminates ambiguity at scaffold time.
